source.title: ProspectMate.lua — original tracking and persistent aggregation implementation
source.author: Urutseg / Mor'Qua Devs

notes: Current ProspectMate main branch (TOC 2.0.4) has Dragon Isles Prospecting spell 374627 and Milling spell 382981. It temporarily collects results per session, but CommitSession saves only SmartProspectorDB.reagents[inputID].consumed and .results[outputID] cumulative quantities, then discards PM.State.results; there is no persisted completed-cast counter, input quality/spec/skill snapshot, 0/1/2 per-output distribution or refund-aware operation ledger. Therefore an ordinary saved-variable export from this implementation cannot reconstruct P(at least one per completed operation), zero counts, or histograms. This is verified tool-data limitation, not a prospecting/milling measurement. No new eligible independent ore/herb cohort emerged from six name-first searches across 6 domains. Existing copied Reddit/Wowhead original datasets were not recounted; unknown fields remain null.
